notes: VAT 16% (Ordonnance-loi 10/001, art. 35); jewellery is excluded from the original-works-of-art exemption (art. 15) and no gold/bullion exemption exists in arts. 15-19, so jewellery and bullion are both 16%. Import duty (DGDA tariff) not readable - HS 7108 line not found on an openable page. No dealer bar list or buyback % found.

sources.name: DRC VAT law - Ordonnance-loi n° 10/001 du 20 août 2010 (leganet.cd)
sources.quote: Le taux de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée est fixé à 16 %.
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 35 fixes VAT at 16%; art. 15 excludes jewellery (orfèvrerie, bijouterie, joaillerie) from the art-works exemption; art. 20 allows no exemptions beyond arts. 15-19.
